name: reschedule_booking
description: Use to move an existing appointment only after collecting the caller's booking reference code. The reference code is required; never identify or authorize a booking by name. Collect the new date and exact time before calling.

reference.description: The required booking reference code supplied by the caller, in GG-0000 form.

date.description: The requested new local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time.description: The requested new local start time in 24-hour HH:mm format.
